mentions.name: flatgate
mentions.description: A Flatpak permission gate inspired by LittleSnitch and Flatseal that default-denies all permissions of newly installed Flatpaks and allows whitelisting per invocation (where possible) or on first use.
mentions.problem: Newly installed Flatpaks come with broad permissions; the tool default-denies them in response to supply chain attack concerns.
mentions.source_excerpt: Second, `flatgate`. This tool is inspired by LittleSnitch and Flatseal. Here the idea is to "default deny" all permissions of newly installed flatpaks and allow/whitelist per invocation (where possible) or on first use.
